content: Dexie.js v4 db.version(2) migration: call db.version(2).stores({medicines: '++id, name, category, location, expiryDate, manualStatus, deletedAt', history: '++id, medicineId, timestamp'}).upgrade(tx => tx.table('medicines').toCollection().modify(m => { m.deletedAt = null; })). The upgrade function populates new fields on existing records. Version 1 must never be modified. Internally Dexie multiplies version numbers by 10. Additive migrations (new table, new index) require .stores() but upgrade() is only needed if you want to set a default value on existing records for the new field — otherwise existing records just lack the field (reads as undefined).
